title: 闭馆

series.next: This note is signed: 第一届社长. The club's first president.

setting: The university library, Chengdu, 11:50 pm. The note said: this time it's real.

zhong.name: 小钟
zhong.en: a student cramming for 考研

steps.narr: On 果果's phone: 邓阿姨's song, from the wedding. 包子 purrs at it.

else.narr: A photo from 何经理: a new sign on room 8.
else.zh: 八号包厢，三点以后，有人唱歌，请勿打扰。

steps.narr: The university library, ten to midnight. On the way in, you pass the reading room: one student, eyes shut, lips moving.

steps.zh: 我不怕。我只是……站在后面。
steps.en: I'm not scared. I'm just... standing at the back.

steps.narr: From the stacks, in the dark: whispering.

say.en: Call into the dark: who's there?
say.tip: 谁在那儿？ = who's there? 那儿 nàr = there.

answers: 谁在那儿？我们不是坏人！
谁在那儿？别怕，我们不是坏人。
3.gloss: Who's there? We're not up to anything!

steps.zh: 白老师十点就走了。门是我锁的。
steps.en: 白老师 left at ten. I locked the doors.

steps.zh: 白日依山尽，黄河入海流……
怎么这么吵？我回来拿伞。
steps.en: What's all this noise? I came back for my umbrella.

steps.narr: In the reading room: the student, asleep now on a pile of books. Her sleeve has ink on it.

say.en: Ask her what time she came in.
say.gloss: What time did you get here?
say.tip: 几点来的？ = what time did you come? 的 at the end asks about a past moment.

answers: 你几点来的？一直没走吗？
你几点来的？是不是一直没走？
3.gloss: What time did you come? Have you been here all along?

say.en: Set the trap: put the moved books back, and see who takes them.
say.gloss: Put the books back, and see who comes for them!
say.tip: 放回去 = put back (where it came from).

ok.narr: Midnight. The whispering starts. A hand reaches for the books: a sleeve, with ink on it.

answers: 把书都放回去，看谁半夜来拿。
书都放回去，看半夜谁来拿。
3.gloss: Put all the books back, and see who comes for them at midnight.

not.note: She left at ten and came back for an umbrella. Whose lips were moving in the reading room?
He has the keys, but who has ink on her sleeve?

say.tip: 念诗 niàn shī = recite poems.

miss.narr: Everyone looks where you're pointing: at 包子. A third time.
包子 turns its back on you, walks to the door, and sits facing the wall.

miss.en: 包子 says it's leaving the club.

3.gloss: It's 小钟! She's reciting poems!

steps.zh: 宿舍太吵了。我怕考不上。
steps.en: The dorm's too loud. I'm scared I'll fail.
The postgrad exam is in twenty days.

say.en: Stay and help her revise, or tell the librarian.
say.tip: 复习 fùxí = revise, review (for an exam).

ok.narr: 阿乐 quizzes her on 古诗 until three. He gets most of them wrong.

then.zh: 以后，阅览室给你留一个位子。
then.en: From now on, there's a desk in the reading room for you.

answers: 别怕，我们陪你复习到考试。
别怕，考试前我们都陪你复习。
3.gloss: Don't be scared. We'll revise with you till the exam.

answers: 这事得告诉白老师，她会帮你。
alts.gloss: We should tell 白老师. She'll help you.

steps.narr: Back at the club: a third note. This one is signed.

steps.en: At 3 am, 小钟 recites the whole poem without looking. 阿乐 gets one line right. 📚

else.en: By morning, a desk in the reading room has a card on it: 小钟. 📚
